checks: One initial dashboard state read; default-off full detail and 100% node sizes
An ordinary SSE reconnect refreshes missed state without a dataset-update toast or workspace reset
Independent sizes and scaled edge ports
A fresh camera initially fits all cards with both saved node sizes at 150%
Animated zoom hands camera control to a pan; fit remains correct afterwards
Custom collapse removes interior DOM and preserves real boundary nodes and canonical topology
A ready alternate pilot remains visible inside a collapsed group and can be followed; pausing tracking removes that protection
Collapsed memberships and scales survive remount
Search reveals and frames a hidden member using final display dimensions
Focus detail preserves selected system and scaled dragging
Ten invalidations coalesce to one active summary/detail pair plus one retained pair
Pilot switch clears scene and isolates display preferences and groups
Empty-map sheets remain above the toolbar and open Display popover; pointer close and Display Escape/focus return work
Delayed detail from the previous map cannot restore its scene after a map switch
Delayed previous-pilot detail cannot replace the current pilot scene
An accepted layout save remains on its original pilot/map; its delayed response does not disturb a switched workspace
Extension page hides old-pilot rows while loading and ignores a delayed superseded response

limitations: The >1ms AND >10% marker is diagnostic, not a new acceptance threshold; no significance claim.
Two matched repetitions on one host; Maps7 and route9 samples per run cannot establish population tails.
RAF summary statistics are verified against retained sample summaries; underlying full frame timestamp arrays are not retained.
Selected Maps hash difference exactly matches prior property-order-only equivalence, not new byte identity across versions.
Diagnostic style mutations do not count React commits; two-cycle heap/listener observations do not establish leak freedom.
No new source change or repeat-to-improve-number recommendation.
